source_text: The Action Plan seeks to address the problems in the centre at the same time as protecting the strengths of Attercliffe and exploiting opportunities including its gateway position to the city, the large number of attractive listed buildings and strong business community.

simplifications.simplification_text: Attercliffe is the gateway to Sheffield, with a strong business community and many attractive listed buildings. This Action Plan aims to capitalise on this, whilst solving the problems in the centre.

source_text: The NDF recommends a number of priority projects to deliver new housing and public realm improvements so that the area changes to become characterised as a safe, high quality and affordable area to live with housing choice, good facilities and a good location in the city.

simplifications.simplification_text: The NDF recommends improvements to housing and public space in the area. These improvements should help the area to be seen as safe, with good and affordable housing.
